images.label: ESO VISTA · infrared, star-aligned

wcsSource.description: Sky anchor is SMASH publisher AVM. Exact native-pixel homography is verified against discrete matched star fields, with held-out residuals and negative controls in source/vista-direction-gate.json. Original VISTA WCS is retained as provenance but not used for geometry.

images.registrationNote: 8954 × 10000 ESO Y/J/Ks image; about 7.7° × 8.6°. Image-to-image scale, rotation and handedness fitted to 16,020 SMASH stars; 5,340 held out, P90 error 0.67 SMASH pixels (~3.3 arcsec), matched hull 83%. Corrected the publisher placement; corners outside the matched hull are extrapolated. The same saved user-authored model fit as SMASH is then applied for display, not as scientific size or simulation registration. Infrared display colors; still partial density coverage. Selected for a full-footprint 2D separation trial; the current 3D reconstruction is unchanged.

images.label: Horálek · optical wide field
images.credit: NOIRLab/NSF/AURA/P. Horálek (Institute of Physics in Opava)
images.registrationNote: Measured registration to SMASH using 592 unique point sources; 198 held out of final fit, median 0.59 SMASH pixels and P90 1.12 pixels (4.996 arcsec/pixel). Homography is an approximation; validated point hull covers 60.2% of source raster, outer area extrapolated. No per-pixel distances or simulation correspondence implied. The same saved image-to-density visual fit is applied as for SMASH. Import and alignment preview only; cloud processing awaits explicit approval. Selected for a full-footprint 2D separation trial; compact residual and diffuse light remain inspectable before a new volume bake.

wcsSource.description: Registered to discrete stars in the pinned full-size SMASH image, whose publisher ICRS TAN AVM supplies the sky anchor. Exact correspondences, held-out residuals and source hull recorded in registration receipt.

images.label: NASA WISE · 24° infrared candidate

wcsSource.description: Exact ICRS TAN WCS from matching CDS HiPS2FITS; JPEG/FITS raster orientation verified. NASA/IPAC data, CDS W4/W2/W1 display-color composition.

images.registrationNote: 24° NASA/IPAC WISE field rendered by CDS as W4/W2/W1 RGB, 6000 × 6000 (~14.6 arcsec/pixel). Fixed publisher WCS verified against 34,811 independently retrieved AllWISE W1 catalogue positions; 11,604 reserved checks, P90 0.632 native WISE pixels, 99.3% matched hull. No geometry correction fitted. This checks position, not diffuse photometry or visible atlas seams. The shared user-authored SMASH model fit is applied separately for display. Selected for a full-footprint 2D separation trial.
